title: Phenotyping and Isolation of Dendritic Cell Subsets by Flow Cytometry
author: Pons, Gardet, et al.

steps.title: Store and mechanically dissociate organs
steps.instruction: Keep spleen and lymph node samples in cold processing medium at 4 °C and process within 2 h; dissociate mechanically either manually (mash over a filter) or with the GentleMACS dissociator (automated). Use the manual method for ≤3 samples, the automated method for larger batches.

steps.title: Collect blood in anticoagulant tube
steps.instruction: Draw peripheral blood into Vacutainer tubes containing heparin‑lithium, EDTA, citrate or CPT anticoagulant, keep at room temperature and process within 2 h.

steps.title: Isolate peripheral blood mononuclear cells
steps.instruction: Perform density‑gradient separation of whole blood to obtain PBMCs, lyse residual erythrocytes, and count viable cells.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the blood 1:1 with PBS 1X.
Prepare 20 mL of 95 % diluted Ficoll‑Paque (19 mL Ficoll‑Paque + 1 mL PBS 1X) in a 50 mL Falcon tube.

Layer the diluted blood over the Ficoll‑Paque without mixing: aspirate blood, tilt the tube almost horizontal, place the pipette tip against the lower wall, release blood slowly, then return the tube to vertical.
Centrifuge at 1,000 g for 20 min at 20 °C with no acceleration or brake.
Harvest the PBMC layer at the plasma‑Ficoll interface; discard the upper plasma layer and transfer cells to a new 50 mL Falcon tube.
Top‑up with PBS 1X and centrifuge at 200 g for 10 min at 20 °C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend the pellet (no added volume).
If needed, add 5 mL of 37 °C pre‑heated RBC lysis solution 1X, incubate 7 min at 20 °C.
Top‑up with PBS 1X and centrifuge at 200 g for 10 min at 20 °C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL PBS 1X (or desired medium, keep at 4 °C).
Determine cell concentration and viability using a hemocytometer.

steps.title: Extract spleen mononuclear cells
steps.instruction: Mechanically dissociate spleen, filter, and apply the same density‑gradient protocol used for PBMCs to obtain spleen mononuclear cells (SMCs).

substeps.instruction: Transfer spleen tissue from the collection tube to a petri dish.
Cut the spleen into ~1 cm³ fragments with a scalpel and tweezers.
Place fragments into four GentleMACS C tubes; add 2 mL processing medium to each tube.
Run the GentleMACS program three times: 60 s dilaceration at 1260 rpr, 20 °C.
Place a 40 µm nylon filter over a 50 mL Falcon tube and humidify the filter with 1 mL processing medium.
Transfer the contents of the GentleMACS tubes onto the filter.
Add up to 30 mL processing medium through the filter to collect the cell suspension.

Perform density separation of the resulting suspension using the PBMC isolation steps 2‑11, splitting the sample across four 50 mL Falcon tubes. Note: the SMC layer appears slightly lower than the PBMC interface.

steps.title: Ex vivo stimulation for cytokine staining
steps.instruction: Stimulate cells with R848 and brefeldin A to trap intracellular cytokines before staining.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 5 × 10⁶ cells into a 5 mL FACS tube (include triplicates, unstimulated and unstained controls).
Add pre‑heated culture medium, centrifuge 200 g for 5 min at 20 °C, and aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 180 µL culture medium with either 10 µM R848 or no stimulant (control).
Incubate 2 h at 37 °C in a 5 % CO₂ incubator.
Add 20 µL culture medium containing 100 µg/mL brefeldin A (final concentration 10 µg/mL in 200 µL); mix gently.
Incubate an additional 2 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ (or longer if required).
Add cold staining buffer, centrifuge 200 g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate, and wash again with cold staining buffer to remove all FBS.

steps.title: Extracellular staining for viability and surface markers
steps.instruction: Stain live cells with viability dye and surface‑marker antibody mixes while keeping all steps at 4 °C and protected from light.

substeps.instruction: Prepare viability buffer by diluting 1 µL LIVE/DEAD Fixable Blue Stain in 1 mL PBS 1X.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 µL viability buffer; incubate 15 min at 4 °C.
Add staining buffer, centrifuge 200 g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 100 µL antibody mix 1 (CD32 blocking antibody + chicken anti‑CADM1) prepared in staining buffer; incubate 30 min at 4 °C, tapping gently every 10 min.
Add staining buffer, centrifuge 200 g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate.
Resuspend pellet in 100 µL antibody mix 3 (remaining extracellular antibodies + donkey anti‑chicken secondary) in staining buffer; incubate 30 min at 4 °C, tapping every 10 min.
Add staining buffer, centrifuge 200 g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate.

steps.title: Fixation and permeabilization
steps.instruction: Permeabilize cells to allow intracellular antibody access.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 200 µL Permeabilization Buffer; incubate 20 min at 4 °C.
Add PermWash solution, centrifuge 200 g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant.

steps.title: Intracellular cytokine staining
steps.instruction: Stain intracellular cytokines with antibody mix 4 in PermWash buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 100 µL antibody mix 4 (cytokine‑specific antibodies) prepared in PermWash solution; incubate 30 min at 4 °C, tapping gently every 10 min.
Add PermWash solution, centrifuge 200 g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate.

steps.title: Streptavidin detection and final fixation
steps.instruction: Add streptavidin for biotin‑based detection, then fix cells.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 100 µL streptavidin buffer (streptavidin diluted in PermWash solution); incubate 30 min at 4 °C.
Add PermWash solution, centrifuge 200 g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate.
Resuspend cells in 200 µL 1 % paraformaldehyde in PBS 1X; keep protected from light.
Store at 4 °C until acquisition (acquire within 12 h).

steps.title: Acquire data on flow cytometer
steps.instruction: Run the stained samples on a BD Fortessa cytometer within 12 hours of fixation.
